name: LAPS Reader
description: LAPS Reader is a Windows PowerShell/WPF GUI tool that retrieves Windows LAPS passwords stored in Intune (Entra) via Microsoft Graph. It signs in to Graph, resolves a device by display name, and displays the local account, password, backup time, and account SID with a one-click copy. Intended for IT/helpdesk staff, it requires the Microsoft.Graph.Authentication module and permissions DeviceLocalCredential.Read.All and Device.Read.All.
author: Reshat Bekteshi

securityCheck.aiSummary: The code implements a legitimate Intune/LAPS password viewer using Graph API. Key security considerations are exposure of plaintext passwords in UI/clipboard, and the remote module installation path (PowerShell Gallery) which could introduce supply-chain risk if not tightly controlled. There are no hardcoded secrets or obvious backdoors. Recommended mitigations focus on access auditing, minimizing in-memory exposure, and controlling module provisioning.
